improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition—Claude-powered AI, instant answers, and free trial searches—within the 155-character limit. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the link is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook, which is critical for a B2B product targeting business owners and traders. These tags are foundational SEO elements that are low-effort but high-impact for organic discovery and social sharing.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it's for (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a clear, low-friction call to action with the free trial offer. The copy is concise, avoids hype, and builds trust by being straightforward about what users get.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for new visitors—what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the paywall and membership value in a straightforward, non-pushy way, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, making visitors more confident about converting.
